_note: Hidden places and rumours (world variety P3, sim/hidden_places.js). Numbers are world units and seconds. flashRange: any of your people this close makes the place flash on the minimap (with a chime); findRange: this close and it is found (a pin on both maps); smudgeRadius: the rumour area drawn on the World map, its middle shifted up to smudgeShift x radius from the place, so the place is always inside it; folkTalkRange: a wandering folk scene tells you a rumour when your hero or crew pass this close (once per scene); folkScenes: the scenes that tell them (the peddler only once saved); townTalkRange / townEverySeconds: one of your own townsfolk tells one when your hero or crew pass this close, at most this often per town; townReach: townsfolk only know places this far from their town; gapSeconds: no two rumours closer together than this. Places: for P3 the seven guarded places of the plan, empty until P4 adds the fights (2026-11-27). Each place: kind (relic or cache), name, x, z, where (the landmark on the World map the rumour names), lines (what people say; one is picked).

relic.label: Relic site
relic.what: A guarded place. Whoever holds it keeps a relic there.

cache.label: Cache
cache.what: Something hidden, waiting for whoever finds it.

places.name: Wreck cove
places.where: the Bone Comb Inlets, on the west shore
lines: A ship broke up in the Bone Comb Inlets, west shore. Smugglers sleep in her hull now.
Stay off the west shore by the Bone Comb Inlets. There is a wreck there, and the men in it shoot.
Smugglers' wreck in the Bone Comb Inlets. Their captain keeps something he will not sell.

places.name: Hermit's cave
places.where: the Stone Sutra Peaks, beside the southern pass
lines: Up in the Stone Sutra Peaks, by the southern pass, a cave smokes at night. A bear sleeps in its mouth.
An old hermit lived in a cave in the Stone Sutra Peaks, near the low pass. Something big lives there now.
There is a cave in the Stone Sutra Peaks, just off the pass road. Nobody who went in for his lantern came out.

places.name: Drowned ferry house
places.where: the Ashen Wash ford in the Thirsting Steps
lines: The old ferry house at the Ashen Wash ford, in the Thirsting Steps. River robbers took it after the flood.
Cross the Ashen Wash in the Thirsting Steps and you pass the drowned ferry house. Pay them or swim.
The ferryman's house at the Ashen Wash ford is full of robbers. They say he hid his charm before he drowned.

places.name: Watch ruin
places.where: the Red Mesa Walls pass, in Rust Mesa
lines: The old watchtower on the Red Mesa Walls pass, in Rust Mesa. A bandit chief sees everything from up there.
Ride the pass through the Red Mesa Walls and the lookouts on the ruined tower will see you first.
In Rust Mesa, where the road climbs the Red Mesa Walls, there is a burnt watchtower. Bandits keep it.

places.name: Abandoned manor
places.where: the Broken Levee Plain, by the east road
lines: A lord's manor stands empty on the Broken Levee Plain, right by the road. Ronin squat in it.
On the Broken Levee Plain there is a manor nobody farms. Masterless men drink there and draw on anyone.
The old manor on the Broken Levee Plain. The ronin inside wear masks when they ride out.

places.name: Buried caravan
places.where: the Dry Well Terraces, in the red desert
lines: A salt caravan went under the sand in the Dry Well Terraces. Raiders are digging it out.
In the Dry Well Terraces the wind uncovered carts. The raiders there blow a great shell horn at dusk.
Out in the Dry Well Terraces, the red desert, men dig for a buried caravan day and night.

places.name: Frozen shrine
places.where: Hollow Bell Heights, above the Lake of Still Bells
lines: Above the Lake of Still Bells, in Hollow Bell Heights, a shrine froze shut. A pale wolf leads the pack there.
Pilgrims left a gourd at the frozen shrine above the Lake of Still Bells. The wolves never let them back.
In Hollow Bell Heights, up from the Lake of Still Bells, the old shrine is ice now. Listen for the howling.

guards._note: World variety P4 (2026-11-27): each guarded place has guards and a boss (sim/guarded_places.js). First clear by a clan = the place's relic (each clan once, player only); a later clear pays repeatRyo. Guards return respawnDays after a clear. Human guards fight with the bandit AI (owner bandits) within leash of the place and see sight far; animals are wild predators that start the hunt when your people come within aggro. Boss numbers and abilities (sim/boss_abilities.js) are first guesses, tuned in play.
guards._patrol: 2026-11-28: the guards walk patrol points patrol[0]-patrol[1] from the place, the boss bossPatrol; one hit or spotting you = the whole band comes (sim/bandits.js rally). Ranged ones kite: bandits.json kiteNear/kiteDistance/kiteSeconds/kiteEvery (defaults 4.5, 6, 1.6, 4.5)
